schema: CREATE TABLE "sensor_logs" ("sensor_id" INTEGER, "reading_date" DATE, "status_code" INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY ("sensor_id", "reading_date"), CHECK ("status_code" >= 0));
correct_query: SELECT first_dt, COUNT(sensor_id) AS total_sensors, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(sensor_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(sensor_id), 2) AS valid_ratio FROM (SELECT sensor_id, MIN(reading_date) AS first_dt FROM sensor_logs GROUP BY sensor_id) AS s GROUP BY first_dt
